name: Fixed-Horizon Thicket Sauer Equality
statement: For $\operatorname{Ldim}(H)\le d$, the class is $(t,d)$-thicket-maximum when its thicket shatter function satisfies $\rho_H(t)=\sum_{i=0}^d\binom{t}{i}$.
hypotheses: Finite Boolean concept class, horizon $t\ge0$, and $\operatorname{Ldim}(H)\le d$.
